newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Banco Santander Chile ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Banco Santander Chile ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency said on Monday it affirmed Banco Santander Chile's A2 short-term, A minus long-term ratings.

"Banco Santander Chile (BSC) is the result of the merger between Banco Osorno y La Union (Bancosorno) and the former Banco Santander Chile, which was completed in early July," IBCA said in a statement. "It is currently the largest private Chilean bank with a market share of around 14 percent."

Banco Santander SA, Spain's largest bank, holds 75 percent of BSC with the remainder split between the former Bancosorno shareholders (7.0 percent), the Chilean public (11 percent) and ADR holders (7.0 percent), the rating agency said.

"The BSC merger represents the forging of two independently strong banks that have benefited from the excellent economic environment which has epitomised Chile in recent years. BSC provides a wide range of services and has a strong presence in all main areas of banking, enjoying good profitability on the back of high interest margins and low loan losses," IBCA said.

"Management has bedded down the merger with impressive speed and efficiency, aided by its previous experience of mergers in both Chile and Peru, which should enable it to consolidate its position as a leading player."
